notes: Born September 8, 1809, County Tyrone, Ireland. Father Richard Law; mother Ann Hunter. Youngest of 5 children; brother Wilson Law. Family immigrated to US c. 1820. Married Jane Silverthorn in Churchville, Upper Canada. 8 children (2 daughters, 6 sons). Counselor in First Presidency 1841-1844; excommunicated. Published Nauvoo Expositor. Died January 19, 1892, Shullsburg, Wisconsin. Irish background - very low probability of pioneer kinship link. No connections found.
